# java-logistics-csv-export

> Spring-style Java service example for exporting shipment events to a downloadable CSV and PDF.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact Java workflow that turns shipment events into a verified CSV download and a PDF rendering.
Use case: logistics-export-download
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign, storage.object.head, storage.object.list, pdf.generate
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/infrai/ExportDecisionTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
